question: The adult literacy rate (15+) for male is ________ against 59.3 of females in 2011
solution:
The correct answer is __**78.8**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adult literacy rate (15+) for males in 2011 is **78.8** against 59.3 for females.
 
• This data highlights the gender disparity in literacy rates in the country.
 
• Efforts have been made to bridge this gap through various educational programs and policies.
 
• Improving literacy rates is crucial for the socio-economic development of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The literacy rate is a key indicator of education and development in a country.
 
• Various schemes such as the National Literacy Mission have been launched to improve literacy rates.
 
• Education is a fundamental right under the Right to Education Act, 2009, in India.
 
• Literacy and education play a significant role in reducing poverty and improving health outcomes.
 
• Increased literacy rates lead to better employment opportunities and economic growth.
